answer: Escalating batch deposits: a wallet's first reward claim needs a 40 POA deposit, the next wallet funded from the same source needs 80, then 160, doubling each time. Ten fakes from one wharf of funding cost 40,950 POA, and 1,000 are out of reach. Deposits stay locked 25 epochs and auditors sample 10% of claims, slashing linked wallets. Honest users with one wallet pay only 40 POA, like one timber log, while a grove of clones gets costly fast.
